reading.body:
Google operates a long-running data center campus in Berkeley County, South Carolina that is part of one of the company's original US sites. The company does not publish power capacity, square footage, or exact addresses for individual buildings at this location. A $500 million expansion specific to Moncks Corner was announced separately from a combined $3.3 billion expansion across two South Carolina campuses announced in September 2024, but the power implications of these investments are not disclosed.

Without published specifications, this campus cannot be ranked by capacity against Google's own other facilities or against competitors. South Carolina has 14 mapped data center facilities total, but only four operators in the state publish power figures. This campus does not appear among those four published figures.

The absence of disclosure at individual building level is Google's stated policy across its data center location pages. Whether this campus matters to AI scaling cannot be determined from published sources. The regional investment announcements signal ongoing expansion, but their translation into megawatts of grid demand and compute density remains opaque.
